idiom_name: nullable reference types with ?. / ?? and LINQ Select/SelectMany
implementation_notes: Nullable reference types and the null-conditional operators ?. / ?[] plus ?? make the 0..1 focus part of the type system: the compiler tracks maybe-null state and warns on an unchecked dereference, and a chain short-circuits to null instead of throwing. The plural traversal is a LINQ query - Where drops absent or non-matching lines and Select maps the rest, with SelectMany flattening nested sequences in one step. These operators and query methods replace the classic optic structure; a hand-written foreach is justified when the update must avoid the deferred-execution and allocation cost of LINQ.
pitfalls: Nullable annotations are compile-time warnings, not runtime guarantees: reflection, deserialization and array element defaults can still put null into a non-nullable member.

?. short-circuits only its own chain - wrapping it in parentheses ((a?.B).C) resumes throwing - and on value types the result becomes a nullable type, so ?? is needed to get back to the non-nullable type.
LINQ is deferred: an update expressed with Select does nothing until the query is enumerated, and enumerating twice re-runs the transformation.
